weather.tip: 95% rain chance tonight — carry an umbrella for the commute home and budget extra time on the usual flood-prone stretches (Silk Board, ORR, Bellandur) once it starts pouring.

around.headline: Bengaluru double-murder probe: police now suspect the child was killed for witnessing his father's murder
around.summary: Investigators say the CCTV at the home was switched off and the phone of the detained woman was wiped clean, and are now probing whether the 4-year-old was smothered because he witnessed his father's killing. Police believe the woman's alleged lover was involved and are still hunting for him.

around.headline: Bengaluru's Clarence High School suspends offline classes after H1N1 outbreak sickens 500+ students
around.summary: The school has moved to suspend in-person classes after H1N1 was confirmed among students who fell ill this week; management had earlier pointed to food from outside street vendors as a possible trigger. If your child shows fever or flu symptoms, keep them home and get tested rather than sending them in.

around.headline: ORR companies push back on WFH plan, want the ₹450-crore road revamp delayed until Metro opens
around.summary: The Outer Ring Road Companies Association has written to the GBA opposing a work-from-home suggestion and asking that the ₹450-crore white-topping project — due to start in October — be pushed back until Metro service on the corridor is running. If you commute along ORR, expect this timeline fight to shape your traffic for months.

around.headline: SDPI's march to the DC office over an NH tollgate snarls traffic today
around.summary: SDPI workers held a 'chalo' march to the Deputy Commissioner's office protesting a national highway tollgate, adding to a day that also saw a political worker arrested for attacking a traffic cop during a related protest. If you're heading near the DC office or a protest route this evening, plan for diversions.

around.headline: "Rs 350 a day just to reach office": fresher's commute-cost complaint to a Bengaluru CEO goes viral
around.summary: A fresher's account of spending Rs 350 a day on commuting has sparked wider debate about Bengaluru's rising cost of living for entry-level workers, with a startup founder separately calling the city's traffic a productivity killer. Worth comparing metro/bus passes against cab costs if your own commute is creeping up.

around.headline: Supreme Court directs Karnataka to comply with Cauvery water-release order to Tamil Nadu
around.summary: The Court has told the state to fall in line with the existing Cauvery Water Management Authority release schedule. Bengaluru draws a large share of its piped water from the Cauvery, so prolonged disputes over release volumes can eventually feed into local supply planning.

street_smart.title: You're at a signal when a political worker's group gets flagged for a violation. Words turn to shoves, and then the traffic cop is being pulled and hit while the crowd just films instead of helping. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Today's report that a JD(S) functionary was arrested for attacking a traffic cop in Bengaluru (The Times of India).
street_smart.situation: You're a few metres away on your bike, engine still running, phone in your pocket. The scuffle is getting louder and more people are drifting toward it — some filming, none stepping in.

choices.text: Push through the crowd and physically pull the attacker off the officer yourself.
choices.feedback: It feels like the brave, obvious move, but wading in alone against a group rarely de-escalates anything — you're more likely to get hurt, get misidentified as part of the brawl by people who arrive after you, or complicate the case as an unplanned, untrained participant instead of a witness.

choices.text: Film it on your phone and post it online right away, without doing anything else.
choices.feedback: Footage genuinely helps — assaulting an on-duty public servant carries specific legal weight, and video is strong evidence. But posting it live for reactions isn't the priority yet, and doing only this means the officer gets no faster help while you're mid-upload.

choices.text: Turn away and ride off — it's not your problem and you don't want to be pulled in as a witness.
choices.feedback: Understandable instinct, but you may already be on someone else's video or nearby CCTV, so 'staying out of it' doesn't fully protect you from being asked questions later — and it does nothing for the officer right now.

choices.text: Call 112 immediately from a safe distance, give the exact location, then keep filming for evidence without closing in.
choices.feedback: Correct. 112 dispatches the nearest patrol/PCR van directly, which is faster real help than one bystander can provide. Staying back keeps you safe while your footage — location, faces, vehicle numbers if visible — becomes usable evidence for the assault case once you hand it to police.

takeaways: Dial 112, not 100, for the fastest police dispatch in Karnataka — it routes straight to the nearest PCR van rather than a general helpline queue.

Filming from a safe distance is legitimate and useful — assault on an on-duty public servant is a specific, more serious charge, and clear video helps that case — but keep enough distance that you don't become part of the scuffle.
Don't intervene physically alone against a group under any circumstance; untrained intervention rarely stops a fight and often adds a second person who needs help.

quiz.question: What was SDPI protesting with today's 'chalo' march to the Deputy Commissioner's office in Bengaluru?
quiz.why: The march added to traffic disruption on a day that also saw a political worker arrested for attacking a traffic cop during a related protest.

quiz.question: Which Bengaluru school suspended offline classes today after H1N1 was confirmed among sick students?
quiz.why: Over 500 students reported illness, with management earlier pointing to food from outside street vendors as a possible trigger.

quiz.question: The Outer Ring Road Companies Association wants Bengaluru's ₹450-crore white-topping project delayed until which milestone?
options: Metro service opens on the ORR corridor
Traffic police approve a new signal plan
quiz.why: The association argued road work now, before Metro is running as an alternative, would worsen an already congested corridor for daily commuters.

quiz.question: Bengaluru draws a large share of its piped drinking water from which river, currently the subject of a Supreme Court compliance order between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu?
quiz.why: Cauvery water is lifted from Torekadanahalli, roughly 100 km from the city and nearly 500 metres in elevation, in one of the country's largest drinking-water pumping systems.

quiz.question: Under India's Constitution, which List assigns 'police and public order' primarily to state governments rather than the Centre?
quiz.why: This is why an assault on an on-duty officer, like today's traffic-cop case, is investigated and prosecuted by Karnataka Police rather than a central agency.
